title: claims of done run the check

clauses.text: A claim of done runs the check, and a pass marks the row done

steps.do: In a workspace with a test command set (commands.test in .iyakki/project.json), ask the assistant to implement one row and then claim it is done.
steps.expect: The check runs itself. A pass marks the row done; a fail returns the output and the row stays open.
